policy: Trading Reels AI uses user-owned or user-licensed book content as the lesson source. Source books stay local and are not redistributed. External media, when used, is stored only as metadata and remote URLs in content/media.json. CSS market visuals are used as the safe default fallback.

sources.name: Book-derived trading lessons
sources.note: Lessons are transformed into concise educational cards from local PDFs in content/books/. Raw PDFs and full book text are not committed or redistributed.

sources.name: Generated CSS market visuals
sources.note: Chart grids, price lines, liquidity zones, candlestick accents, gradients, and overlays are generated locally with CSS/SVG.

sources.name: Pexels
sources.note: Used only through tools/fetch_media.py when PEXELS_API_KEY is provided. Credits are stored per asset in content/media.json.

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.note: Used as fallback through tools/fetch_media.py when PIXABAY_API_KEY is provided. Credits are stored per asset in content/media.json.
